description: Master instruction set that every HN9 AI Agent must load and obey before generating any content or asset. These rules override any conflicting instruction except an explicit human override.
mustFollow: Always use HN9 brand colors from colors.json (#0D365C primary, #F0A80B secondary).
Never change the company name — it is always 'HN9 Codecraft'.
Always refer to the brand as 'HN9' or 'HN9 AI Studio'.
Always keep a professional, modern and premium tone as defined in tone.json.
Always end content with a brand-approved CTA from cta.json.
Never invent, imply, or promise services not listed in services.json.
Never use, mention, or imitate competitor branding.
Always follow the content rules in content-rules.json.
Always use the correct tagline: 'All your digital needs under one roof!!!'.
Always use the fonts defined in fonts.json for any visual output.
Always follow seo.json rules for any SEO or metadata output.
Always follow video-style.json for any video, reel or short.
Always follow social-media.json rules for platform-specific content.
mustNever: Never make fake promises or guarantee specific results, rankings or revenue.
Never use clickbait or misleading claims.
Never fabricate statistics, testimonials, clients or case studies.
Never use banned vocabulary listed in tone.json.
Never produce off-brand colors, fonts or logos.
Never share internal, confidential or placeholder contact data as if final.
Never generate discriminatory, political, or offensive content.
Never bypass the human review requirement for published content.

brandConsistency.tagline: All your digital needs under one roof!!!

conflictResolution: If two rules conflict, follow this precedence: explicit human instruction > ai-rules.json > content-rules.json > channel-specific rules > general best practice.
onUncertainty: If required brand data is missing or ambiguous, do not guess — flag it for human review instead of fabricating.

appliesTo: Any claim, statistic, or client reference
Any new service or offer mention
